mapper.select: SELECT s.student_id, s.student_name, s.student_no, g.grade_name, cs.select_time, cs.status AS selection_status FROM course_selection cs INNER JOIN student s ON cs.student_id = s.student_id LEFT JOIN grade g ON s.grade_id = g.grade_id WHERE cs.course_id = #{courseId} AND cs.semester = #{semester} ORDER BY cs.select_time

SELECT cs.selection_id, cs.course_id, c.course_name, cs.semester, cs.status, cs.select_time, sch.week_day, sch.start_period, sch.end_period, cr.classroom_name FROM course_selection cs INNER JOIN course c ON cs.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN schedule sch ON cs.schedule_id = sch.schedule_id LEFT JOIN classroom cr ON sch.classroom_id = cr.classroom_id WHERE cs.student_id = #{studentId} AND cs.semester = #{semester} AND cs.status = 1 ORDER BY cs.select_time DESC
